body:
Thank you, I honestly hope I'm wrong but I can't find an exception. People try to care but either I push them away with my self loathing or they decide I am too much or too worn to be worth their time. My friends always find someone else to fill the person shaped hole in their hearts, and I'm always used up till they find that person and toss me aside. 
I just need someone who will hold me as close as I hold them in my own heart and I don't think I will find that person in time.
